Here is the comprehensive analysis of the SuperChant Android project.

---

## Comprehensive Summary: SuperChant

### 1. What the App Does (Purpose)

SuperChant is a **minimalist digital mala / chanting counter** for Android. It is designed for focused spiritual practices -- specifically **japa meditation, mantra chanting, prayer counting, and repetitive spiritual practices** where users traditionally use physical mala beads (108 beads). Instead of beads, the app uses the phone's physical volume buttons to count each repetition, allowing the user to keep their phone in their pocket, face-down, or with the screen off while chanting -- maintaining focus on their practice rather than their screen.

The app's marketing tagline (from `strings.xml`): **"A distraction-free digital mala for your spiritual practice"**

**Play Store short description:** "Distraction-free chanting counter. Use volume buttons to count without looking."

---

### 2. All Key Features (from code -- not assumptions)

| # | Feature | Evidence (file:line) |
|---|---------|----------------------|
| 1 | **Volume button counting** -- press volume up OR down to increment count | `VolumeKeyAccessibilityService.kt:147-178` |
| 2 | **Traditional mala count** -- 108 counts per round (hardcoded constant) | `ChantState.kt:45` (`COUNTS_PER_ROUND = 108`) |
| 3 | **Foreground service** -- runs in background with persistent notification | `ChantingService.kt` (startForeground, START_STICKY) |
| 4 | **Volume keys consumed** -- pressing volume does NOT change volume during active session | `VolumeKeyAccessibilityService.kt:178` (returns `true` to CONSUME) |
| 5 | **Pause / Resume** sessions | `ChantingService.kt:262-269` (pauseSession, resumeSession) |
| 6 | **Haptic feedback** -- two independent vibration settings: per-count (light tap) and per-round-complete (stronger pulse with N repetitions for Nth round) | `ChantingService.kt:343-384` (vibrateCount, vibrateRoundComplete) |
| 7 | **Customizable vibration intensity** -- sliders for count intensity (1-255, default 80) and round intensity (1-255, default 255) | `PreferencesRepository.kt:76-95`, `SettingsScreen.kt:130-172` |
| 8 | **Goals with multiple mantras** -- create structured sessions with named mantras and target rounds per mantra | `ChantState.kt:52-72` (Goal, MantraGoal models), `GoalsScreen.kt` |
| 9 | **Goal progress tracking** -- visual progress of each mantra within a goal during active session | `HomeScreen.kt:632-779` (GoalProgressDisplay composable) |
| 10 | **Auto-advance through mantras** -- when one mantra's rounds are completed, automatically moves to next | `ChantingService.kt:295-306` |
| 11 | **Goal completion celebration** -- ringtone sound + special vibration pattern when all mantras done | `ChantingService.kt:322-324, 387-420` |
| 12 | **Mantra section complete sound** -- notification sound when a single mantra section finishes | `ChantingService.kt:400-408` |
| 13 | **Drag-to-reorder mantras** -- in goal editor, long-press drag to reorder mantras | `GoalsScreen.kt:440-446` (ReorderableItem + reorderable library) |
| 14 | **Session history** -- all completed sessions saved, viewed with time categorizations (Today, This Week, This Month, Older) | `HistoryScreen.kt:74-77` (categorizeSessions) |
| 15 | **All-time stats** -- total counts, rounds, sessions, and total time displayed in history | `HistoryScreen.kt:265-323` (SummaryCard) |
| 16 | **Clear history** with confirmation dialog | `HistoryScreen.kt:192-215` |
| 17 | **Dark / Light / System theme** toggle | `SettingsScreen.kt:94-113`, `Theme.kt:81-83` (ThemeMode enum) |
| 18 | **Animated UI** -- spring-animated counter ring, pop-scale on count, animated visibility of elements, animated navigation transitions | `CounterDisplay.kt:47-67`, `MainActivity.kt:48-71` |
| 19 | **Mala bead visual ring** -- 27 bead indicators around the counter circle that fill as progress increases | `CounterDisplay.kt:121-134` |
| 20 | **Landscape support** -- separate landscape layout with horizontal arrangement | `HomeScreen.kt:356-441` (LandscapeContent) |
| 21 | **Screen-off counting** -- works when screen is off (accessibility service intercepts keys system-wide) | `VolumeKeyAccessibilityService.kt` |
| 22 | **Persistent notification** -- shows live count/round progress with Pause/Stop actions | `ChantingService.kt:442-529` (buildNotification) |
| 23 | **Session restore on system kill** -- START_STICKY + state preservation in onDestroy | `ChantingService.kt:123-136, 143-176` |
| 24 | **100% local data** -- no accounts, no network, no analytics, no ads | `PRIVACY_POLICY.md`, zero network permissions in manifest |
| 25 | **Accessibility setup helper** -- guides users through enabling accessibility service, handles Android 13+ restricted settings for sideloaded apps | `HomeScreen.kt:444-629` (two dialogs) |
| 26 | **Notification permission handling** (Android 13+) with runtime permission launcher | `HomeScreen.kt:128-150` |

---

### 3. How Users Interact With It

**Primary interaction: Volume buttons**
- User opens app, taps **Start**
- If accessibility service not yet enabled, guided through setup dialogs
- Once session is active, pressing **volume up OR volume down** increments the count by 1
- The volume key press is **consumed** (volume does NOT change)
- This works even with screen off or in another app
- Counter goes from 0 to 108, then rolls over (completing 1 round)

**Secondary interactions:**
- **Start/Stop button** -- begins or ends a session
- **Pause/Resume** -- via notification action buttons when in background
- **Goal selection** -- pick a pre-defined goal (collection of mantras with round targets), tap "Start Session", and the app auto-tracks progress through each mantra
- **Notification panel** -- shows current count, round progress, allows pause/resume/stop without opening the app

**Setup flow:**
1. User taps Start --> accessibility not enabled --> dialog appears
2. Dialog opens Android Accessibility Settings
3. User finds "SuperChant Volume Counter" and toggles it ON
4. User returns to app, taps Start again --> session begins

---

### 4. Tech Stack

| Category | Technology |
|----------|-----------|
| **Language** | Kotlin 2.0.21 |
| **UI Framework** | Jetpack Compose (via BOM 2024.12.01) |
| **Material Design** | Material 3 |
| **Navigation** | Jetpack Navigation Compose (string routes: "home", "settings", "history", "goals") |
| **State Management** | `StateFlow` + `collectAsState()` owned by foreground service (no ViewModels) |
| **Persistence** | DataStore Preferences (JSON-serialized lists stored as strings) |
| **Serialization** | kotlinx.serialization.json |
| **Architecture** | Foreground Service (`START_STICKY`) + Accessibility Service |
| **Background Work** | Coroutines with `SupervisorJob` + `Dispatchers.Main` |
| **Min SDK** | 26 (Android 8.0 Oreo) |
| **Target/Compile SDK** | 35 |
| **Java Target** | 17 |
| **Drag & Drop** | `org.burnoutcrew.composereorderable:reorderable:0.9.6` |
| **Testing** | JUnit 4, Espresso, Compose UI Test |
| **Distribution** | Google Play Store Internal Testing, APK/AAB built via custom Gradle tasks |

**Custom theme colors:**
- Light: Warm saffron/amber primary (`#C4956A`), warm off-white background (`#FFFBF8`), earthy brown secondary
- Dark: Golden amber primary (`#FFB95A`), deep warm black background (`#16130F`)
- Special: Counter gold (`#D4A574` light / `#FFB95A` dark) for the mala ring visualization
- Dynamic color (Material You) is **disabled by default** to preserve the spiritual aesthetic

**Data models:**
- `ChantState` -- immutable data class, single source of truth (count, rounds, active goal, mantra progress)
- `Goal` -- collection of `MantraGoal` entries with IDs
- `SessionRecord` -- completed session with start/end time, counts, rounds, linked goal
- `UserPreferences` -- theme mode, vibration settings

---

### 5. Screenshots in the Project

**No screenshots exist in the repository.** The only image file is:
- `/Users/dhruv2mars/dev/github/superchant/docs/play-store/icon-512.png` -- a 512x512 app icon for the Play Store listing

The Play Store listing document (`docs/play-store/STORE_LISTING.md:137-144`) provides **screenshot guidance** suggesting what to capture:
1. Home Screen (Idle) -- Counter at 0, Start button visible
2. Active Session -- Counter showing some counts, rounds completed
3. Goals Screen -- optional
4. History Screen -- optional

No actual screenshots have been taken yet.

---

### 6. App Version

From `/Users/dhruv2mars/dev/github/superchant/app/build.gradle.kts` (lines 27-28):
- **versionCode: 2**
- **versionName: "1.1.0"**

The version is also displayed in-app on the Settings screen via `BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME`.

---

### 7. Existing Marketing Copy

**From `strings.xml`:**
- `app_name`: "SuperChant"
- `app_description`: "A distraction-free digital mala for your spiritual practice"
- `accessibility_service_label`: "SuperChant Volume Counter"
- `accessibility_service_summary`: "Allows volume buttons to count chants without changing volume"
- `accessibility_service_description`: Full paragraph explaining the accessibility service purpose and limitations

**From `docs/play-store/STORE_LISTING.md`:**
- **Short description (78 chars):** "Distraction-free chanting counter. Use volume buttons to count without looking."
- **Full description (structured):** Covers distraction-free counting, traditional mala experience (108 counts), goals & multiple mantras, session history, thoughtful design (themes, background operation), privacy focus (no accounts, no analytics, no ads), and how the accessibility service works.
- **Category:** Health & Fitness (alternative: Lifestyle)
- **Tags:** meditation, chanting, mala, japa, mantra, counter, prayer, spiritual, mindfulness, beads
- **Content Rating:** Everyone
- **Privacy Policy URL:** https://github.com/dhruv2mars/superchant/blob/main/PRIVACY_POLICY.md

**From `SettingsScreen.kt` (line 187):**
- "A distraction-free digital mala for your spiritual practice" (displayed in About section)

**From `PRIVACY_POLICY.md`:**
- Full privacy policy emphasizing zero data collection, local-only storage, accessibility service limitations (canRetrieveWindowContent=false), no third-party services, and open-source verifiability.

---

### Architecture Summary

```
User presses Volume Up/Down
        |
        v
VolumeKeyAccessibilityService (intercepts, consumes event)
        |
        v (SharedFlow)
ChantingService (foreground service, owns ChantState StateFlow)
        |
        +---> Increments count, checks rounds, advances mantras/goals
        +---> Triggers vibrator (count tap or round pulse)
        +---> Updates persistent notification
        +---> Saves session to DataStore on stop
        |
        v (collectAsState)
MainActivity -> HomeScreen (Compose UI)
        |
        +---> CounterDisplay (animated ring + number)
        +---> GoalProgressDisplay (mantra checklist)
        +---> RoundsDisplay (rounds completed)
        +---> StartStopButton
```

**Screens:** Home, Settings, History, Goals (plus embedded GoalEditor when creating/editing)

**Data flow:** All state originates in `ChantingService` as a shared `MutableStateFlow<ChantState>`. The UI observes via `collectAsState()`. Preferences are stored in DataStore as JSON strings and exposed as Kotlin Flows by `PreferencesRepository`.

SuperChant

A distraction-free digital mala for your spiritual practice

--- ## What is SuperChant? SuperChant is a minimalist Android app to count mantras using your phone's **volume buttons** — no screen needed. Keep your phone in your pocket, face-down, or with the screen off and stay focused on your practice. Built for japa meditation, mantra chanting, prayer counting, and any repetitive spiritual practice. ## Features ### Core - Press volume up or down to increment your count - 108 counts per round — just like a traditional mala - Works with screen off or in any other app - Foreground service with persistent notification - Pause and resume sessions anytime ### Goals & Tracking - Create structured goals with multiple mantras - Set target rounds per mantra — auto-advances when complete - Drag-to-reorder mantras in the goal editor - Session history with time-based categorization (Today, This Week, This Month, Older) - All-time stats: total counts, rounds, sessions, and practice time ### Customization - Light, dark, and system theme modes - Adjustable vibration intensity for counts and round completions - Haptic feedback on each count and round milestone - Celebration ringtone on goal completion ### Privacy - 100% local — all data stays on your device - No accounts, no sign-up, no internet permission - No analytics, no tracking, no ads - [Read the privacy policy](PRIVACY_POLICY.md) ## Download Get the latest APK from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Dhruv2mars/superchant/releases/latest). ## Build from Source ```bash git clone https://github.com/Dhruv2mars/superchant.git cd superchant ./gradlew assembleDebug # Debug APK ./gradlew buildReleaseApk # Signed release APK ``` **Requirements:** Android Studio Hedgehog+ / JDK 17 ## Tech Stack | Layer | Tech | |-------|------| | Language | Kotlin 2.0.21 | | UI | Jetpack Compose + Material 3 | | Navigation | Jetpack Navigation Compose | | State | StateFlow + Foreground Service | | Persistence | DataStore Preferences + kotlinx.serialization | | Architecture | AccessibilityService + Foreground Service | ## How It Works SuperChant uses Android's [AccessibilityService](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/accessibilityservice/AccessibilityService) to intercept volume button presses system-wide. When a session is active, the service consumes the key event so volume doesn't change — it just increments the counter. The accessibility service does **not** read screen content (`canRetrieveWindowContent = false`), does not interact with other apps, and only activates during user-initiated sessions. ## License MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE) for details.
